kaju.name: Kaju the crow
kaju.goal: Order your chai like a real Mumbaikar
kaju.greeting: Arre, new face! What will you have, boss?
kaju.win: Kaju says: "Your usual?" You're a regular now!
kaju.bust: Tourist! Kaju made you a chai tea latte. With a straw.

openers.means: Brother, give me two cutting chais

mangesh.name: Mangesh the mongoose
mangesh.goal: Get a fair ride on the meter
mangesh.win: Mangesh waived the last ten rupees. "For you, boss."
mangesh.bust: Tourist! Mangesh turned the radio up and gave you the full guided tour.

mor.name: Mor Aunty
mor.goal: Charm her at the wedding (free talk)
mor.greeting: Arre beta, you came! Have you eaten? Whose side are you from, bride or groom?
mor.win: Mor Aunty pulled you into the family photo!
mor.bust: Tourist! Mor Aunty sent you to the buffet line, the long one.

openers.means: Hello Aunty! I'm from the bride's side

openers.say: Haan Aunty, the food is too good
openers.means: Yes Aunty, the food is really good
